task.title: Store profiles for the portfolio: pilot profile sneakers end to end (profile format + seed switch + price ratio table + theme bridge T0h + profile home blocks + Replicate images with a consistency gate + catalog copy in 5 locales + fresh-DB verify on :9023/:8028), then nine more profiles (orchestrator store-profiles, Opus, ultracode)
task.details:
Ivan's directive 2026-09-07 (verbatim in docs/prompts/2026-09-07-ivan-directive-ten-store-versions.md): ten store versions with their own photos, colour theme, graphics and catalog copy as portfolio examples; role subagents on Opus or higher; quality over cost; autonomous to the result; first one version → Ivan's eyes → the other nine. Architect's decisions: docs/store-profiles/00-program-2026-09-07.md (F1 one DB per profile, F2 nano-banana-2 primary / flux-2-pro fallback / flux-1.1-pro-ultra raw for lifestyle, F3 bytes re-hosted to apps/backend/static + raw archive never deleted, F4 preset on the canon dictionary with the 88-variable bridge, F5 classic card in wave 1, F6 pilot = sneakers, F7 en+de/fr/es/ru, F8 stand :9023/:8028 in worktree feat/store-profiles). Proposed goal: the storefront on http://localhost:8028/en reads as a real sneaker brand's shop seeded from data/profiles/sneakers (14 products, sizes × colourways, ≥3 generated images each, copy matching the renders, own theme, hero and category tiles), verified from a fresh DB. Proposed acceptance (machine): store-profile:validate sneakers green with counts | seed into a fresh DB prints N products / M variants / K images | every image URL 200 | tsc, next lint, next build green | seed and storefront unit tests + Playwright profile specs green with reverse runs red | T0h.5 four-page pixel delta ≤ 0.1 % on medusa/light | verify report artifacts/docs/2026-09-07-store-profile-sneakers-verify.json with every check and its reverse run, counts copied. Proposed acceptance (Ivan's eyes on :8028): home reads as a sneaker brand's shop (photo banner + headline + button, four category tiles, product shelf) | one product's four photos show the same shoe and the swatches match the photos | every title names what its photo shows | descriptions read as written by a shop | size and colourway selectable, price changes | one palette on home, listing, product, cart | no clipped title or price at phone width. Orchestrator brief: docs/prompts/initial-prompt-2026-09-07-orchestrator-store-profiles.md. Estimates: est-store-profiles-pilot-sneakers, est-store-profiles-wave2-nine (@upready/estimation). Wave 2 (nine profiles, T0j card variants, T0i panel) starts only after Ivan accepts the pilot.

Ivan 2026-09-07 (after the cost breakdown): «давай пока только по 1 кадру все» → the pilot renders ONE frame per product (hero shot only; no angle, detail, lifestyle or colourway shots), one hero banner render, one render per category tile = 19 renders, at most 57 with regenerations (was 90–160). Acceptance lines replaced accordingly: 'every product has ≥1 image that loads' and 'on a product page the photo shows the shoe and the colourway named by the title and swatch'; layout hover = none. Brief S2/S3/S4/S5/S7, program F9/§5/§7/§8/§9, schemas (images minItems 1, shots minItems 1, counts.images min 10) and the estimate (tokens $16–47, renders 19–57) updated in the same turn.

Ivan 2026-09-07, second clarification: «по 1 кадру на изображение, т.е. по 1 ракурсу; перегенерации можно потом сделать вторым проходом, если будут ошибки» → exactly 19 renders in the pilot run, NO regenerations; a frame failing the checklist stays in the catalog marked flagged (manifest status accepted|flagged|rejected) and is listed in artifacts/media/sneakers/second-pass.json; the second pass is a separate order from Ivan. Brief S4, program F9/§9, media-manifest schema and the estimate notes updated.

The validator exit-code defect the orchestrator found earlier was already fixed by S1a itself (both paths now exit non-zero); the earlier reading of exit 0 was taken from an in-progress version. S3 commit 616b09e, 10 files. Orchestrator recount from the JSON matches the report exactly: products 14, variants 225, imageRefs 14, shotShapes ['1:hero'], descMin 551, descMax 683, specMin 8, specMax 10, singleVariant 2, priceMin 9, priceMax 189, 5 locales. 2026-09-07 21:2x-21:4x WITA. GATE S1 CLOSED — all four zones in history. Commits: 3d67e11 (S1a), 616b09e (S3), ee6cfff (S1c + three orchestrator-only fixes), 55666fa (S1b), f66076f (S2). S1c: 18 mockup frames, 3 new components (ProfileHero, CategoryTiles, ImageFrame), PromoBanner and Thumbnail rewired in place with Thumbnail byte-identical when no imageTreatment is declared; 19 vitest + 13 Playwright green, 1 Playwright skipped (asserts the html data-image-* attributes, unskip at S7), 7 reverse runs RED-then-GREEN. THREE FIXES ONLY THE ORCHESTRATOR COULD MAKE, each verified before acting: (1) deleted the dead 'export const PRODUCT_LIMIT = 12' from collections/[handle]/page.tsx — Next 15 rejects a non-standard page export and it took tsc AND next build down; proven dead first (all consumers import it from modules/store/templates/paginated-products.tsx:8, llms.txt has its own local const, zero importers), recoverable from 20610a9; (2) added storefront scripts themes:build, themes:extract, profile:build, predev, prebuild, test:profile; (3) added enable-pre-post-scripts=true to the root .npmrc because pnpm 8.12.0 (the one on PATH) SKIPS pre/post scripts while the pinned 10.11.1 runs them — measured by S1c. Orchestrator's own gate run after the fixes: TSC_EXIT=0, BUILD_EXIT=0. S1b T0h.5 GREEN: home 0 px, category 469 px (0.0458%), PDP 621 px (0.0606%), cart 0 px, budget 0.1%. HONEST DEVIATION recorded in the commit: the baseline is bridge-OFF vs bridge-ON in the SAME run, not a pre-change screenshot — all four pages were 500 during the window when a 'before' capture would have been taken; [data-theme-bridge=off] disables every bridge row and the control re-injects the two globals.css declarations the step removed. The noise floor was itself a finding: control-vs-control first gave PDP 5526 px (0.54%) from thumbnails mid-decode, then 50066 px (4.9%) because product photos come from a remote S3 bucket through next/image and one run had the photo where the other had the placeholder; after waiting on img.complete, serving every image as one identical transparent pixel, hiding Next's dev badge and masking the promo strip another agent was regenerating mid-run, the floor is 0 px on all four pages. First bridge pass had the PDP at 1660 px (0.162%) because --fg-subtle diverged by 1.19/255, which lands on every antialiased glyph edge (Medusa has three ink levels, the canon two; the anchor went to text-ui-fg-subtle, 117 call sites vs 39). A bridge row is judged against what the storefront RENDERS, not the raw vendor value — judging by the vendor value classified --fg-interactive as diverged and had the bridge reproduce Medusa's blue-500, silently undoing the WCAG correction with every test green. 113 preset variables measured, not 88. Restored next-env.d.ts and tsconfig.json to HEAD before committing (Next rewrites them per NEXT_DIST_DIR; committing pins the repo to one agent's dist dir); tests/theme/probe.mjs and capture.mjs left uncommitted as measurement scratch (the deletion guard refused their rm — they are gitignored-free scratch, Ivan decides). S4 RUNNING: 19 paid renders. Orchestrator smoke-ran its prompts.mjs (rule 19c) and CONFIRMED the money-losing defect is fixed in code: packshotBody keeps 'A single right shoe' (right for the 11 footwear), stillLifeBody does NOT contain it and leaks no undefined, STILL_LIFE_ARRANGEMENT covers exactly care-kit / flat-waxed-laces / round-waxed-laces, TILE_SUBJECTS covers exactly the four tiles.
